papers.title: Drug Gene-Set Analysis Identifies Established and Emerging Therapeutic Mechanisms
papers.translated_title: 药物基因集分析识别出已确立和新兴的治疗机制
papers.author: Bell, N. Y.
papers.summary: Developing novel disease therapies is challenging, especially for central nervous system (CNS) disorders, which have a clinical approval rate of 6.2%. Genetic evidence is associated with higher success rates in drug development, but systematically translating genome-wide association study (GWAS) signals into actionable therapeutic hypotheses remains difficult. Here, we present DRUGSETS, a framework that tests whether drug (n = 8,136) and mechanism-of-action (MoA; n = 384) gene sets are enriched for GWAS associations. We applied DRUGSETS to five CNS and five non-CNS phenotypes using competitive gene-set analysis with both the standard MAGMA gene-level statistic and Polygenic Priority Scores (PoPS). Both implementations were enriched for approved treatments, and drug gene set significance was associated with further progression in clinical trials. Across all ten phenotypes, we identified 69 MoA and 589 drug gene set-associations that were study-wide significant, finding both established and novel pharmacological targets. Non-CNS traits were enriched for immune, hemostatic and metabolic mechanisms. Psychiatric disorders converged on mechanisms regulating neuronal excitation/inhibition, and Alzheimer's disease was enriched for immune-related mechanisms and amyloid aggregation. DRUGSETS identifies shared and disease-specific therapeutic biology, including mechanisms not targeted by current treatments. DRUGSETS is available as an open-source tool and is being integrated into FUMA.
papers.translated_summary: 开发新型疾病疗法具有挑战性，尤其是中枢神经系统（CNS）疾病，其临床批准率为6.2%。遗传证据与药物开发中更高的成功率相关，但系统地将全基因组关联研究（GWAS）信号转化为可操作的治疗假设仍然困难。在此，我们提出DRUGSETS，一个用于检验药物（n = 8,136）和作用机制（MoA；n = 384）基因集是否富集GWAS关联的框架。我们使用竞争性基因集分析，结合标准MAGMA基因水平统计量和多基因优先级评分（PoPS），将DRUGSETS应用于五种CNS表型和五种非CNS表型。两种实现均在已批准治疗中富集，且药物基因集显著性临床试验的进一步进展相关。在所有十种表型中，我们识别出69个MoA和589个药物基因集关联达到研究范围显著性，发现了既有和新的药理学靶点。非CNS性状富集于免疫、止血和代谢机制。精神疾病集中于调节神经元兴奋/抑制的机制，阿尔茨海默病富集于免疫相关机制和淀粉样蛋白聚集。DRUGSETS识别了共享和疾病特异性的治疗生物学，包括当前治疗未靶向的机制。DRUGSETS作为开源工具提供，并正在整合到FUMA中。

papers.title: Same-day hybrid capture workflow for diagnosis and surveillance of respiratory pathogens
papers.translated_title: 当日混合捕获流程用于呼吸道病原体的诊断与监测
papers.author: Buggiotti, L.
papers.summary: Hybrid capture approaches can detect a broad range of pathogens directly from clinical samples with greater sensitivity than untargeted approaches. Clinical adoption has been limited by long turnaround times, complex workflows, and perceived high costs. We iteratively developed and validated a rapid hybrid capture workflow based on Illumina's RPIP protocol (standard workflow). Rapid-RPIP v1 reduced wet-lab time from ~11.4 to ~7.3 h, for a turnaround time (TAT) of <15 h. Rapid-RPIP v2 further reduced wet-lab time by ~0.7 h and used Illumina Turbo Sequencing shortening the sequencing time from ~5.5 to ~2.5 h thus achieving a TAT of <10 h without compromising sensitivity and yielding higher RPKMs for RNA viruses than the standard workflow. This approach could be readily adapted to a broad range of clinical and public health applications.
papers.translated_summary: 杂交捕获方法可直接从临床样本中检测广谱病原体，灵敏度高于非靶向方法。临床采用一直受限于周转时间长、工作流程复杂以及被认为成本高昂。我们基于Illumina的RPIP方案（标准工作流程）迭代开发并验证了一种快速杂交捕获工作流程。Rapid-RPIP v1将湿实验时间从约11.4小时缩短至约7.3小时，周转时间（TAT）<15小时。Rapid-RPIP v2进一步将湿实验时间缩短约0.7小时，并使用Illumina Turbo测序将测序时间从约5.5小时缩短至约2.5小时，从而在不影响灵敏度的情况下实现<10小时的TAT，并且对RNA病毒产生的RPKM高于标准工作流程。该方法可 readily 适用于广泛的临床和公共卫生应用。

papers.title: Universal coordinate on wave-shape manifold of cardiovascular waveform signal for dynamic quantification and cross-subject comparison
papers.translated_title: 心血管波形信号波形流形上的通用坐标用于动态量化和跨受试者比较
papers.author: Wu, H.-T.
papers.summary: Objective: Quantifying physiological dynamics from nonstationary time series for clinical decision-making is challenging, especially when comparing data across different subjects. We propose a solution and validate it using two real-world surgical databases, focusing on underutilized arterial blood pressure (ABP) signals. Method: We apply a manifold learning algorithm, Dynamic Diffusion Maps (DDMap), combined with the novel Universal Coordinate (UC) algorithm to quantify dynamics from nonstationary time series. The method is demonstrated using ABP signal and validated with liver transplant and cardiovascular surgery databases, both containing clinical outcomes. Sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess robustness and identify optimal parameters. Results: UC application is validated by significant correlations between the derived index and clinical outcomes. Sensitivity analyses confirm the algorithms stability and help optimize parameters. Conclusions: DDMap combined with UC enables dynamic quantification of ABP signals and comparison across subjects. This technique repurposes typically discarded ABP signals in the operating room, with potential applications to other nonstationary biomedical signals in both hospital and homecare settings.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：从非平稳时间序列中量化生理动力学以支持临床决策具有挑战性，尤其是在比较不同受试者的数据时。我们提出一种解决方案，并使用两个真实手术数据库进行验证，重点关注未被充分利用的动脉血压（ABP）信号。方法：我们应用流形学习算法动态扩散映射（DDMap），结合新颖的通用坐标（UC）算法，从非平稳时间序列中量化动力学。该方法使用ABP信号进行演示，并通过肝移植和心血管手术数据库进行验证，两者均包含临床结局。进行了敏感性分析以评估稳健性并确定最佳参数。结果：UC应用通过衍生指标与临床结局之间的显著相关性得到验证。敏感性分析确认了算法的稳定性并有助于优化参数。结论：DDMap结合UC能够实现ABP信号的动态量化及跨受试者比较。该技术重新利用了手术室中通常被丢弃的ABP信号，在医院和家庭护理环境中对其他非平稳生物医学信号具有潜在应用价值。

papers.title: A quantitative approach to evidence triangulation: development of a framework to address rigour and relevance
papers.translated_title: 证据三角互证的定量方法：构建一个兼顾严谨性与相关性的框架
papers.author: Shapland, C. Y.
papers.summary: Triangulation is an approach to strengthen causal inference by integrating evidence from multiple sources. Most studies using triangulation have qualitatively examined whether different studies agree upon the presence of a causal effect, rather than estimated the effect by quantitatively integrating results. Here, we develop a framework for quantitative triangulation. We first address how to relate study specific research questions to an overall target causal question (relevance) and then assess the directions and magnitudes of bias in each study (rigour), before combining the results using meta-analysis adjusted for the biases. We illustrate our framework by triangulating evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs), Mendelian randomization (MR) and conventional multivariable regression (MVR) to estimate the effect of beta-carotene on coronary heart disease (CHD) and cardiovascular disease (CVD). Five RCTs and one MR study showed little evidence of a causal relationship between beta-carotene and CHD (relative risk (RR)=1.00 with 95% CI=0.98 to 1.01 and RR=1.02 with 95% CI=0.98 to 1.07, respectively). Thirteen MVR studies indicated that high intake of beta-carotene reduces CHD risk (RR=0.83 with 95% CI=0.76 to 0.91). After applying our framework, the three study designs agreed that there is no strong evidence against the null hypothesis that beta-carotene intake does not affect risk of CHD (RR=0.99 with 95% CI=0.82 to 1.21). Findings were similar for CVD. Our framework shows how to address rigour and relevance quantitatively when triangulating evidence from different study designs. We highlight the importance of explicitly defining the target and study-specific research questions. Our framework shows how to address rigour and relevance quantitatively when triangulating evidence from different study designs. We highlight the importance of explicitly defining the target and study-specific research questions.
papers.translated_summary: 三角互证是一种通过整合多来源证据来强化因果推断的方法。多数使用三角互证的研究仅定性考察不同研究是否在因果效应的存在性上一致，而非通过定量整合结果来估计效应。在此，我们开发了一个定量三角互证的框架。我们首先处理如何将各研究特定研究问题与总体目标因果问题相关联（相关性），然后评估每项研究中偏倚的方向和幅度（严谨性），之后在调整偏倚的荟萃分析中合并结果。我们通过三角互证随机对照试验、孟德尔随机化和传统多变量回归的证据来估计β-胡萝卜素对冠心病和心血管疾病的影响，以说明我们的框架。五项随机对照试验和一项孟德尔随机化研究几乎未显示β-胡萝卜素与冠心病之间存在因果关系的证据（相对风险分别为1.00，95%置信区间0.98至1.01；以及1.02，95%置信区间0.98至1.07）。十三项多变量回归研究表明，高摄入β-胡萝卜素可降低冠心病风险（相对风险0.83，95%置信区间0.76至0.91）。应用我们的框架后，三种研究设计一致认为，没有强有力的证据反对β-胡萝卜素摄入不影响冠心病风险的零假设（相对风险0.99，95%置信区间0.82至1.21）。心血管疾病的研究结果类似。我们的框架展示了在三角互证不同研究设计的证据时，如何定量处理严谨性和相关性问题。我们强调了明确定义目标研究问题和各研究特定研究问题的重要性。我们的框架展示了在三角互证不同研究设计的证据时，如何定量处理严谨性和相关性问题。我们强调了明确定义目标研究问题和各研究特定研究问题的重要性。

papers.title: Three Cerebellar Imaging Subtypes in Schizophrenia with Distinct Spatiotemporal Trajectories and Biological Characteristics
papers.translated_title: 精神分裂症中具有不同时空轨迹和生物学特征的三类小脑影像亚型
papers.author: Liu, Z.
papers.summary: The potential role of the cerebellum in the pathophysiology of schizophrenia has received relatively insufficient attention. Prior studies characterized cerebellar abnormalities mainly at the group level, without fully considering the heterogeneity of the disease. Here, we applied a machine learning approach (Subtype and Stage Inference, SuStaIn) to cross-sectional 3D volumetric MRIs of the cerebellum, including a total of 3,550 individuals with schizophrenia (1423 females; mean age: 32.3 +/- 12.0 years) and 5,771 healthy controls (HC) (2,861 females; mean age: 32.5 +/- 12.9 years), from 34 sites worldwide. SuStaIn identified three distinct spatiotemporal trajectories in cerebellar gray matter volume reduction, respectively originating in lobule X (subtype 1), lobule III (subtype 2) and lobule VIIb (subtype 3), with subtypes 1 and 3 corresponding to the posterior lobe and subtype 2 to the anterior lobe. These trajectories were cross-sectionally inferred in 1,588 individuals with schizophrenia and replicated in another independent samples of 1,334 and 628 patients, respectively. Multimodal analyses using neuroimaging, transcriptomic and behavioral data revealed subtype-specific biological characteristics in brain morphological patterns, cerebellar-cortical connectivity, gene expression and clinical symptoms. Specifically, subtype-related genes were enriched in metabolism-related processes and immunity-related processes, respectively, in subtype 1 and subtype 2; subtype 3 showed more severe brain abnormalities and worse cognitive symptoms. Treatment data from 381 patients, with up to 12 months of follow-up, revealed poorer response to antipsychotic medications in subtype 2 and subtype 3, but better response to transcranial magnetic stimulation in subtype 1, which also had worse emotion-related symptoms. Together, our findings offer a comprehensive characterization of the heterogeneity of cerebellar pathophysiological progresses in schizophrenia, which may help in developing future clinical stratification and targeted intervention strategies.
papers.translated_summary: 小脑在精神分裂症病理生理学中的潜在作用相对而言未得到足够关注。既往研究主要在组水平上刻画小脑异常，未充分考虑疾病的异质性。本研究采用机器学习方法（亚型与分期推断，SuStaIn）对横断面小脑三维容积MRI进行分析，纳入来自全球34个中心的3,550例精神分裂症患者（1,423例女性；平均年龄：32.3 +/- 12.0岁）和5,771名健康对照（HC）（2,861例女性；平均年龄：32.5 +/- 12.9岁）。SuStaIn识别出小脑灰质体积减少的三种不同时空轨迹，分别起源于小叶X（亚型1）、小叶III（亚型2）和小叶VIIb（亚型3），其中亚型1和亚型3对应后叶，亚型2对应前叶。这些轨迹在1,588例精神分裂症患者中被横断面推断，并分别在另外1,334例和628例患者的独立样本中得到重复验证。利用神经影像、转录组和行为数据的多模态分析揭示了亚型特异性的生物学特征，涉及脑形态模式、小脑-皮层连接、基因表达和临床症状。具体而言，亚型相关基因在亚型1和亚型2中分别富集于代谢相关过程和免疫相关过程；亚型3表现出更严重的脑异常和更差的认知症状。来自381例患者、随访长达12个月的治疗数据显示，亚型2和亚型3对抗精神病药物治疗的反应较差，而亚型1对经颅磁刺激的反应较好，且其情绪相关症状更差。综上，本研究对小脑在精神分裂症中病理生理进展的异质性提供了全面刻画，可能有助于未来制定临床分层和靶向干预策略。

papers.title: EEG Biomarkers for Rett Syndrome: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning with Explainable AI
papers.translated_title: Rett综合征的EEG生物标志物：机器学习与深度学习及可解释AI的比较分析
papers.author: Gupta, M.
papers.summary: Rett syndrome (RTT) is a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by abnormal cortical activity, which can be captured using electroencephalography (EEG). Although machine learning (ML) has shown promise for diagnosing several neurological conditions, comprehensive evaluation of classical ML and deep learning (DL) methods, together with physiologically meaningful explanations, remains limited for RTT. This study analyses resting-state, eyes-closed EEG recordings from RTT patients and healthy controls using both power spectral density (PSD)-based ML and end-to-end DL frameworks. Classical ML models, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forest, and XGBoost, were trained on PSD features, while EEG-specific DL architectures, including ShallowConvNet, DeepConvNet, EEGNet, and EEG Conformer, were trained directly on preprocessed EEG signals. Subject-wise cross-validation was used to avoid data leakage, with balanced accuracy as the primary performance metric because it equally accounts for sensitivity and specificity. Random Forest achieved the best performance among the classical ML models, whereas EEGNet achieved the highest DL performance. An ablation study indicated that 4-second EEG epochs offered the optimal trade-off between model performance and robustness. Model interpretability was investigated using SHAP for Random Forest and occlusion sensitivity analysis for EEGNet. Both methods consistently identified delta and theta oscillations, along with centro-frontal brain regions, as key contributors to RTT classification. These findings show that both PSD-based machine learning and end-to-end deep learning methods can reliably identify RTT and highlight common neurophysiological biomarkers, offering an interpretable framework for EEG-based diagnosis and biomarker discovery for Rett Syndrome.
papers.translated_summary: Rett综合征（RTT）是一种罕见的神经发育障碍，其特征是皮层活动异常，可通过脑电图（EEG）捕捉。尽管机器学习（ML）在诊断多种神经系统疾病方面已显示出前景，但针对RTT的经典机器学习与深度学习（DL）方法的综合评估，以及具有生理学意义的解释，仍然有限。本研究使用基于功率谱密度（PSD）的机器学习和端到端深度学习框架，分析了RTT患者和健康对照者的静息态闭眼脑电图记录。经典机器学习模型，包括支持向量机、随机森林和XGBoost，在PSD特征上进行训练，而脑电图专用的深度学习架构，包括ShallowConvNet、DeepConvNet、EEGNet和EEG Conformer，则直接在预处理后的脑电信号上进行训练。采用按受试者划分的交叉验证以避免数据泄漏，并以平衡准确率作为主要性能指标，因为它同等考虑敏感性和特异性。随机森林在经典机器学习模型中取得了最佳性能，而EEGNet取得了最高的深度学习性能。消融研究表明，4秒的脑电片段在模型性能与稳健性之间提供了最佳权衡。模型可解释性通过随机森林的SHAP和EEGNet的遮挡敏感性分析进行研究。两种方法一致地将delta和theta振荡以及中央-额叶脑区识别为RTT分类的关键贡献因素。这些发现表明，基于PSD的机器学习和端到端深度学习方法均能可靠地识别RTT，并揭示了共同的神经生理生物标志物，为基于脑电图的Rett综合征诊断和生物标志物发现提供了一个可解释的框架。

papers.title: Working from home a few times a month to a few times a week is associated with higher psychological distress: between- and within-person analyses of a five-wave panel of employees in Japan
papers.translated_title: 每月居家办公几次到每周居家办公几次与更高的心理困扰相关：基于日本员工五波面板数据的个体间与个体内分析
papers.author: Fuse, S.-i.
papers.summary: Purpose To estimate the association between the frequency of working from home (WFH) and psychological distress among employees in Japan, separating between-person from within-person differences, and to examine this association by sex and household circumstances. Methods We used five annual waves (2021-2025) of the nationwide Japan COVID-19 and Society Internet Survey (JACSIS), including 39,773 employees aged [≥] 18 years who worked in the past month (78,498 person-waves). The exposure was the frequency of WFH in the past month (seven categories). The outcomes were the Kessler 6 (K6) score (0-24), K6 [≥] 5, and K6 [≥] 13. We used within-between linear regression, overall and by sex and household circumstances at the first wave. Results Compared with no WFH, WFH 2-3 times a month, once a week, and 2-3 times a week was associated with K6 scores higher by 1.99, 1.80, and 0.67 points between persons and by 0.53 (95% CI 0.28, 0.77), 0.45 (0.20, 0.69), and 0.35 (0.10, 0.60) points within persons, and with a 3.5-4.6 percentage point higher probability of K6 [≥] 5 within persons. These within-person K6 differences were positive in all sex and household groups (0.20-0.63 points) but imprecise. For the other frequencies, the within-person differences were 0.03-0.20 points. Conclusion WFH 2-3 times a month or once a week, and also 2-3 times a week, was associated with higher psychological distress, both between and within persons. Support for employees who sometimes work from home should consider the frequency of WFH together with their work and family situations.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 估计日本员工居家办公（WFH）频率与心理困扰之间的关联，区分个体间差异与个体内差异，并按性别和家庭状况检验该关联。方法 我们使用了全国性日本COVID-19与社会互联网调查（JACSIS）的五个年度波次（2021-2025年），纳入39,773名年龄≥18岁且在过去一个月内工作过的员工（78,498人-波次）。暴露变量为过去一个月内居家办公的频率（七个类别）。结局变量为Kessler 6（K6）评分（0-24）、K6≥5和K6≥13。我们采用个体内-个体间线性回归，分别进行总体分析以及按第一波次的性别和家庭状况分层分析。结果 与不居家办公相比，每月居家办公2-3次、每周一次和每周2-3次与K6评分在个体间分别高出1.99、1.80和0.67分相关，在个体内分别高出0.53（95% CI 0.28, 0.77）、0.45（0.20, 0.69）和0.35（0.10, 0.60）分相关，并与个体内K6≥5的概率高出3.5-4.6个百分点相关。这些个体内K6差异在所有性别和家庭组中均为正值（0.20-0.63分），但估计不精确。对于其他频率，个体内差异为0.03-0.20分。结论 每月居家办公2-3次或每周一次，以及每周2-3次，与更高的心理困扰相关，无论在个体间还是个体内均如此。对有时居家办公的员工的支持应综合考虑居家办公频率及其工作和家庭状况。

papers.title: Source-water salinity measured by electrical conductivity in Bangladesh, 2025: a nationally representative cross-sectional survey
papers.translated_title: 2025年孟加拉国以电导率测量的水源盐度：一项具有全国代表性的横断面调查
papers.author: Hoque, S. M. A. U.
papers.summary: BackgroundIn coastal Bangladesh, saline drinking water has been linked to raised blood pressure. The 2025 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) measured electrical conductivity (EC), a salinity indicator, in source water, but its report gave no population counts or district estimates. ObjectivesTo estimate how many people live in households whose tested source has high EC, and to describe patterns by place, household characteristics, source type and arsenic. MethodsEC was measured in source water of 6,040 households in 64 districts, February to June. In 14.5% of households the tested source was not the main drinking-water source. Primary outcomes were EC above 1,500 and 3,000 {micro}S/cm, survey risk classes that are not health-based standards. Estimates were survey weighted; comparisons were observational. ResultsEC exceeded 1,500 {micro}S/cm in 5.3% of households (95% CI 4.7 to 5.9), about 9.0 million people, including 1.8 million above 3,000 {micro}S/cm. Coastal-zone districts held 26% of households but 70% of those above 1,500 {micro}S/cm. Shares varied little by wealth or in households with young children or pregnant women. Nationally, deep tube wells more often had high EC because most are coastal. In the coastal zone, deep and shallow wells had similar shares (16.1% and 17.9%). After district adjustment, EC was about 18% lower in deep wells (geometric mean ratio 0.82, 0.73 to 0.92). Within upazilas (restricted sample) it was 0.93 (0.80 to 1.07). Arsenic above 10 ppb was more common where EC was high, but this link weakened after district adjustment. ConclusionsMillions of people live in households whose tested source has high EC, mostly in coastal and south-central districts. Deep wells had modestly lower EC after geographic adjustment, but the difference shrank within upazilas and depended on the handling of implausibly low readings. The findings support measuring EC alongside arsenic, with documented meter calibration.
papers.translated_summary: 背景在孟加拉国沿海地区，咸化饮用水与血压升高有关。2025年多指标类集调查（MICS）测量了水源水的电导率（EC），这是盐度的一项指标，但其报告未给出人口数量或地区估计。目标估算有多少人居住在所检测水源EC较高的家庭中，并按地点、家庭特征、水源类型和砷含量描述其分布模式。方法于2月至6月在64个地区的6，040户家庭的水源水中测量EC。在14.5%的家庭中，所检测水源并非主要饮用水源。主要结局为EC高于1，500和3，000微西门子/厘米，这是调查风险分类，并非基于健康的标准。估计值经调查加权；比较为观察性。结果5.3%的家庭EC超过1，500微西门子/厘米（95% CI 4.7至5.9），约900万人，其中180万人超过3，000微西门子/厘米。沿海地区各区占家庭总数的26%，但在EC超过1，500微西门子/厘米的家庭中占70%。不同财富水平以及有幼儿或孕妇的家庭中，这一比例差异不大。在全国范围内，深管井更常有高EC，因为大多数位于沿海。在沿海地区，深井和浅井的比例相似（16.1%和17.9%）。经地区调整后，深井的EC约低18%（几何均值比0.82，0.73至0.92）。在乌帕齐拉内（受限样本）为0.93（0.80至1.07）。砷高于10 ppb的情况在EC高之处更常见，但这一关联在地区调整后减弱。结论数百万人居住在所检测水源EC较高的家庭中，主要位于沿海和中南部地区。经地理调整后，深井的EC略低，但差异在乌帕齐拉内缩小，并取决于对不合理低读数的处理。研究结果支持在测量砷的同时测量EC，并记录仪器校准情况。

papers.title: Insomnia and the genetic overlap of sleep with depression and anxiety: a genomic structural equation modelling study
papers.translated_title: 失眠与睡眠和抑郁及焦虑的遗传重叠：一项基因组结构方程模型研究
papers.author: Sakiroglu, M. A.
papers.summary: Insomnia, depression and anxiety co-occur and share genetic liability, but a genetic correlation cannot show whether that liability is spread across the sleep domain or concentrated in insomnia, a diagnostic criterion for depression and generalized anxiety disorder. We applied genomic structural equation modelling to ten genome-wide association studies and fitted a four-factor model of sleep, internalizing (depression and anxiety), psychotic-bipolar and metabolic liability. A model linking the sleep and internalizing domains only through their factor correlation was inadmissible, and we compared, under one decision rule, each one-parameter link that could repair it: domain-wide links, an insomnia-specific cross-loading, and residual covariances representing shared diagnostic content, of which three were admissible. The insomnia cross-loading fitted better than the only admissible domain-wide alternative ({Delta}AIC = 13.8; better in 98.6% of 500 Monte Carlo draws) and than shared content ({Delta}AIC = 96.9), and placing it on psychotic-bipolar or metabolic liability was inadmissible. Under this model the insomnia pathway carried 56.3% of the sleep-internalizing covariance (95% CI 45.6-67.0%). A second sleep pathway improved fit ({Delta}AIC = -33.3), but with three sleep indicators its location was not identifiable, and across the equivalent models the insomnia share ranged from 0% to 127.0%. At the variant level, no internalizing lead departed from depression-anxiety proportionality after correction, and internalizing leads replicated in FinnGen, with partial sample overlap, whereas sleep leads did not (60.4%; P = 0.17). How concentrated the overlap is will require finer sleep phenotypes to establish. Among single-link models, insomnia is the best-supported location of the overlap.
papers.translated_summary: 失眠、抑郁和焦虑共同发生并共享遗传易感性，但遗传相关无法表明该易感性是分布在整个睡眠领域，还是集中于失眠——失眠是抑郁和广泛性焦虑障碍的一项诊断标准。我们对十项全基因组关联研究应用了基因组结构方程模型，拟合了一个包含睡眠、内化（抑郁和焦虑）、精神病-双相和代谢易感性的四因子模型。仅通过因子相关连接睡眠和内化领域的模型不可接受，我们在同一决策规则下比较了每种可修复该模型的一参数连接：领域-wide连接、失眠特异性交叉载荷，以及代表共享诊断内容的残差协方差，其中三种可接受。失眠交叉载荷的拟合优于唯一可接受的领域-wide替代方案（{Delta}AIC = 13.8；在500次蒙特卡洛抽样中98.6%更优），也优于共享内容（{Delta}AIC = 96.9），而将其置于精神病-双相或代谢易感性上则不可接受。在该模型下，失眠通路承载了56.3%的睡眠-内化协方差（95% CI 45.6-67.0%）。第二条睡眠通路改善了拟合（{Delta}AIC = -33.3），但在三个睡眠指标下其位置无法识别，且在等效模型间失眠占比范围为0%至127.0%。在变异水平上，校正后没有内化先导变异偏离抑郁-焦虑比例性，内化先导变异在FinnGen中重复，存在部分样本重叠，而睡眠先导变异则未重复（60.4%；P = 0.17）。重叠的集中程度需要更精细的睡眠表型来确定。在单连接模型中，失眠是重叠位置的最佳支持。

papers.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists (GLP-1RAs) for treatment of tobacco and alcohol dependence: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
papers.translated_title: GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）治疗烟草和酒精依赖：随机对照试验的系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Taylor, G.
papers.summary: Background Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) might reduce tobacco and alcohol use. We synthesised evidence from randomised controlled trials (RCTs) on smoking and alcohol outcomes, including secondary outcomes reported in trials conducted for other clinical purposes. Methods We searched MEDLINE, Embase, PsycINFO, Web of Science, CENTRAL, PubMed, and registries for RCTs comparing GLP-1RAs with placebo from inception to August 18, 2026. Smoking and alcohol outcomes were synthesised using random-effects meta-analyses. We assessed risk of bias (RoB) with RoB-2, and certainty of evidence with the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach. Findings Fourteen trials involving 1149 participants were included; 13 contributed to meta-analyses. Across the 14 trials, 8 recruited participants not seeking either tobacco or alcohol treatment. The other 6 recruited treatment-seeking participants: 3 for tobacco and 3 for alcohol. Eight trials reported smoking-related outcomes, 11 reported alcohol outcomes, and 5 reported both. Follow-up ranged from 6 to 60 weeks. All 4 pooled smoking-related estimates favoured GLP-1RAs, although all 95% CIs included no difference and were compatible with increases and decreases in outcomes; e.g., smoking cessation, OR 1.39 (95% CI, 0.77 to 2.53, k=3). Restricting analyses to semaglutide trials indicated a reduction in cigarettes per day (CPD) (SMD=-0.10, 95%CI:-0.16 to -0.04; k=3). Across agents, pooled estimates favoured GLP-1RAs for days without alcohol (SMD=0.35, 95%CI: 0.12 to 0.59, k=3). Pooled estimates of semaglutide-only trials also favoured treatment for alcohol consumption (grams/day; SMD=-0.56, 95%CI:-0.82 to -0.30; k=2), craving (SMD=-0.60, 95%CI:-0.91 to -0.29; k=2), drinks per drinking day (SMD=-0.59, 95%CI:-0.86 to -0.32; k=3), drinks per calendar day (SMD=-0.48, 95%CI:-0.87 to -0.09; k=2) and heavy drinking days (SMD=-0.45, 95%CI:-0.85 to -0.06; k=3), and alcohol-free days (SMD=0.41, 95%CI:0.09 to 0.73; k=2). Two of 41 assessed results were at low RoB, 31 raised some concerns and 8 were at high risk; certainty was moderate for 1 outcome, low for 4 and very low for 8. Interpretation GLP-1RAs may reduce alcohol consumption and CPD, with the clearest evidence for semaglutide. These findings should be contextualised by most evidence being low- to very-low-certainty. Larger trials are needed to establish clinically meaningful benefit and sustained abstinence.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）可能减少烟草和酒精使用。我们综合了随机对照试验（RCT）中关于吸烟和酒精结局的证据，包括为其他临床目的开展的试验中报告的次要结局。方法 我们检索了MEDLINE、Embase、PsycINFO、Web of Science、CENTRAL、PubMed以及注册库，纳入从建库至2026年8月18日比较GLP-1RAs与安慰剂的RCT。吸烟和酒精结局采用随机效应荟萃分析进行综合。我们使用RoB-2评估偏倚风险（RoB），并使用推荐意见分级评估、制定与评价（GRADE）方法评估证据确定性。结果 共纳入14项试验，涉及1149名参与者；其中13项纳入荟萃分析。在14项试验中，8项招募的参与者未寻求烟草或酒精治疗。其余6项招募了寻求治疗的参与者：3项针对烟草，3项针对酒精。8项试验报告了吸烟相关结局，11项报告了酒精结局，5项同时报告两者。随访时间为6至60周。所有4项吸烟相关合并估计均倾向于GLP-1RAs，尽管所有95%CI均包含无差异，且与结局的升高和降低均相容；例如，戒烟，OR 1.39（95%CI，0.77至2.53，k=3）。将分析限制于司美格鲁肽试验显示每日吸烟支数（CPD）减少（SMD=-0.10，95%CI：-0.16至-0.04；k=3）。跨药物汇总，合并估计倾向于GLP-1RAs对无酒精天数的改善（SMD=0.35，95%CI：0.12至0.59，k=3）。仅司美格鲁肽试验的合并估计也倾向于治疗对酒精消耗量（克/天；SMD=-0.56，95%CI：-0.82至-0.30；k=2）、渴求（SMD=-0.60，95%CI：-0.91至-0.29；k=2）、每个饮酒日的饮酒量（SMD=-0.59，95%CI：-0.86至-0.32；k=3）、每个日历日的饮酒量（SMD=-0.48，95%CI：-0.87至-0.09；k=2）和重度饮酒天数（SMD=-0.45，95%CI：-0.85至-0.06；k=3）以及无酒精天数（SMD=0.41，95%CI：0.09至0.73；k=2）的改善。在41项评估结果中，2项为低偏倚风险，31项存在一些担忧，8项为高偏倚风险；1项结局的证据确定性为中等，4项为低，8项为极低。解释 GLP-1RAs可能减少酒精消耗和CPD，其中司美格鲁肽的证据最为明确。这些发现应结合大多数证据为低至极低确定性这一背景来理解。需要更大规模的试验来确定具有临床意义的获益和持续戒断。
